DIAGNOSIS READY: Hemophilia A or B (Inherited Bleeding Disorder).

The patient is an 18-month-old boy with spontaneous knee swelling after minor activity and a family history of similar issues, which is highly suggestive of a congenital clotting factor deficiency rather than trauma or arthritis.
